title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #16: Rio Grande, Finlay, Quitman and Cornudas Mts.
description: Black-and-white oblique orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#16" with a north arrow at upper left. Handwritten labels include "Cornudas Mts.", "Salt Basin", "Finlay Mts.", "Quitman Mts.", "Rio Grande R." and "U.S. MEXICO" along the river valley running diagonally across the image.
